_note: External evidence batch 2 checks against. Kept OUT of data/lab.csv on purpose: lab.csv feeds calibrate, the params fit and the frozen split, and adding a row there would move 053's fitted parameters (spec section (a); audit review). Each anchor is used for exactly what its 'use' says.

khan2019_chicken_biryani.citation: Khan I, Yasmeen F, Ahmad J et al. Progress in Nutrition 2019;21(2):421-429, doi:10.23751/pn.v21i2.6928, Table 2
khan2019_chicken_biryani.dish: Chicken biryani, home recipe (Peshawar; five housewives' recipes averaged and cooked in a lab kitchen; proximate analysis in duplicate, wet basis)
khan2019_chicken_biryani.use: moisture target of STEADY:chicken_biryani_home_v1 (its K505 water line); energy reported as a cross-check on the lab convention 4P + 9F + 4(CHO + fibre)

nin_poha_cup.citation: NIN Dietary Guidelines for Indians 2011, Annexure 8 and the sample meal plans ('Cereals 50 g -> Poha 1 cup', 'Poha 1 cup 270 kcal')
nin_poha_cup.use: cross-check only: the batch-2 poha's energy per 50 g of dry flakes against NIN's 270 kcal (reported, not gated: it fixes energy per gram of grain, not moisture)

nin_upma_cup.citation: NIN Dietary Guidelines for Indians 2011, Annexure 8 and the sample meal plans ('Cereals 50 g -> Upma 1 cup', 'Upma 1 cup 270 kcal')
nin_upma_cup.use: cross-check only: the batch-2 upma's energy per 50 g of dry rava against NIN's 270 kcal (reported, not gated)

cofid_12_468_urad_dahl.citation: McCance and Widdowson's Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset (CoFID, 2021 release), food 12-468 'Urad dahl, homemade' (University of Leeds analytical survey of South Asian home dishes, 2007)
cofid_12_468_urad_dahl.dish: Black lentil (urad) curry, homemade (UK South Asian households; 5 home samples, lab proximate analysis)
cofid_12_468_urad_dahl.use: moisture only: the water OSR139's water line is simmered down to (STEADY:dal_makhani_home_v1). It is a plain urad dal with no butter or cream, so its energy and fat are reported for reference and never compared with dal makhani (founder 2026-11-15, spec section (i) decision 6; docs/testing/dal-makhani-research-2026-11-14.md)

nin_dhal_half_cup.citation: NIN Dietary Guidelines for Indians 2011, Annexure 8 and the sample meal plans ('Pulses 20 g -> Dhal 1/2 cup', 'Plain dhal 1/2 cup 100 kcal'; a NIN cup is 200 ml)
nin_dhal_half_cup.use: cross-check only: the batch-2 dal makhani's energy per 20 g of dry pulse against NIN's plain dhal (reported, not gated; dal makhani carries butter and cream, so it should sit above a plain dhal)
